article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Bryce Harris had 24 points in Howard's 72-64 victory against Alcorn State on Thursday. Harris also contributed nine rebounds for the Bison (2-2). Travelle Bryson added 12 points while going 6 of 12 from the field while they also had six rebounds. Ose Okokie had 10 points and finished 5 of 8 from the floor. Shane Lancaster led the Braves (0-5) in scoring, finishing with 14 points. Jameel Morris added 12 points and four steals for Alcorn State. Tycen McDaniels had 11 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
